audience: Puzzle fans looking for something new: searches for hexagon, triangle, mosaic or tile puzzles; the game's own signature for ads.
story: One picture cut four ways, the hexagon board up close, then Painting, giant boards, the daily picture and the dark finale.
promotionalText: One picture, four ways to cut it: cards, squares, triangles and hexagons. New shapes open as you level up, and the trickier ones pay a little more.
deepLinkNote: None: the shapes open by level, so there is no screen that shows all four to a new player.

slides.note: The hook: the default four-shapes slide.
The hexagon board mid-build: locked, loose and joined hexagons.
